name: pnp-spfx-copilot-apps-portfolio-carryover-review
title: Portfolio Carryover Review
shortDescription: Review initiatives carried over between fiscal years, including their status, ownership, and carryover rationale.
longDescription: Portfolio Carryover Review helps IT portfolio managers review initiatives carried over from previous fiscal years. It provides a consolidated view of initiative status, ownership, reasons for carryover, and planned review dates. The sample uses mock data to demonstrate how portfolio carryover information can be explored directly in Microsoft Copilot.
